label: GO after an unrewarded trial, moderately committed to a2, mid-episode
explanation: Update-gate unit that fires almost only at GO (99.7% of mass), and only when the previous trial was unrewarded (prev_reward=0 holds 99.7% of mass; it never fires after a reward) and the agent is about to choose a2 (99.8% of mass; the policy logit is in a moderate a2 band, -8.9 to -4.4, and it never fires when the logit favours a1). Firing also depends strongly on time within the episode: concentrated at trials 15-65 and silent after trial 70, which suggests a slow drift in the hidden state. GO & prev_reward=0 & a2 alone gives recall 0.95 / mass 0.996 but precision only 0.14. Adding the episode window and the moderate-logit band raises F1 to 0.69 on dev, and that is what I recorded. It uses only observed or computed quantities (the policy logit at that same GO step and the trial index), no future variables. In the top examples, activation rises over runs of consecutive unrewarded a2 GO steps; this was seen in examples only, not tested systematically. It does not fire at D1 at all, and only negligibly at D2. Precision is still incomplete, so this is partial.
